# proxmox_ha_armed (Resource)

Arms HA fencing on create (`POST /cluster/ha/status/arm-ha`) and disarms it on destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_ha_armed" "a" {
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `armed` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
